results.title: Cyberabad police seize 100 tonnes of chicken waste in raids
results.description: Hyderabad: The Cyberabad police and veterinary officials seized 100 tons of chicken waste during raids across the commissionerate on Monday, August 24. According to the police, the accused sold the chicken waste to fish pond owners in Andhra Pradesh. Veterinary officials warned that consuming fish fed with chicken waste could cause cancer.
